Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in whcih their vehicle was
struck from the side while turning left. The reported mechanism and force are
consistent with the cervical strain diagnosed at intake. Care was delivered over 41
visits, consisting of manual therapy, supervised therapeutic exercise, and home
exercise instruction. The course followed a typical progression, with visit frequency
tapering as symptoms and range of motion improved. Several examination findings,
including limited cervical rotation and paraspinal muscle tenderness, support the
diagnosis, while neurological screening and reflex testing were within normal limits.
The patient reports a remote, minor strain to the same region in the past that resolved
completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single charges for each
service rendered, with no duplicate entries.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
